test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states of India is Padayani a ritual dance art form performed at Bhadrakali temple?
solution: The correct answer is **__Kerala__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • A ceremonial dance involving masks is an ancient ritual performed in **Bhagavati** temples. • The dance is performed in honor of Bhadrakaali. Meaning, a '**row of warriors**', • **Padayani **is an art form that blends music, dance, theatre, satire, facial masks, and paintings.
